# Boston University

> > Boston University's digital resources spanning computer science infrastructure, library research guides, and academic services.

BU maintains diverse online resources including technical infrastructure like the Computer Science Department's Tor exit node for privacy research, and extensive library collections supporting language learning and academic research across multiple disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Boston University
- Boston University Libraries
- Computer Science Department
- Tor network
- cryptographic anonymity
- language learning
- research guides
- library resources
- Igbo culture
- network privacy
- academic resources

## Computer Science & Network Infrastructure

- [BU Computer Science Tor Exit Node](http://cs-tor.bu.edu/): Boston University Computer Science Department's Tor network exit node supporting cryptographic anonymity and privacy research

## Library & Research Resources

- [Igbo Language Learning Guide](https://library.bu.edu/igbo): Comprehensive research guide for Igbo language learning, culture, and resources curated by Boston University Libraries
